subject: Glial Surface Protein DIP-β Extends Lifespan in Flies: A Molecular Bridge to Brain Aging
script: From Agewell Brief: Glial Surface Protein DIP-β Extends Lifespan in Flies: A Molecular Bridge to Brain Aging. New in-situ proteomics reveals that a single glial cell-surface protein, DIP-β, declines with age and its restoration extends lifespan, illuminating the biophysical basis of glia-neuron communication. For over a century, neuroscience has fixated on neurons. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
